sources.name: get
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; cd "$D" && printf '['; s=''; for f in $(ls 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(brown|pink|white|deep|rain)\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.s$' | head -5); do printf '%s"%s"' "$s" "$f"; s=,; done; printf ']'

sources.name: put
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; case "$HATCH_ARG" in *.s) ;; *) echo "not a noise file" >&2; exit 1;; esac; printf '%s' "$HATCH_ARG" | grep -qE '^(brown|pink|white|deep|rain)\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.s$' || { echo "bad noise file" >&2; exit 1; }; rm -f "$D"/*.s; : > "$D/$HATCH_ARG"; printf '{}'

sources.name: say
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; case "$HATCH_ARG" in brown|pink|white|stop) ;; *) echo "bad command" >&2; exit 1;; esac; printf '{"c":"%s","t":%s}' "$HATCH_ARG" "$(date +%s%3N)" > "$D/cmd"; printf '{}'

sources.name: beat
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; printf "%s" "$HATCH_ARG" | grep -qE "^(brown|pink|white|deep|rain)\.[0-9]{1,15}$" || { echo "bad beat" >&2; exit 1; }; printf "%s" "$HATCH_ARG" > "$D/playing"; printf "{}"

sources.name: last
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; F="$D/playing"; grep -qE "^(brown|pink|white|deep|rain)\.[0-9]{1,15}$" "$F" 2>/dev/null || { printf "{}"; exit 0; }; IFS=. read -r c e < "$F"; printf "{\"c\":\"%s\",\"e\":%s,\"age\":%s}" "$c" "$e" "$(( $(date +%s) - $(stat -c %Y "$F") ))"
